text:
sasha: Heads-up — noticed a regression in the canary for PR #8421 (microbatch allocator change). p95 for long-seq went from ~48ms -> ~130ms on the canary shards. Also seeing a mem p95 bump ~200MB on the longseq workload. posting raw bench link: s3://redwood-ci/bench/3370004321/8421-canary

kai: ugh. do we have a perf diff artifact? can you paste the bench summary?

essie (pr-bot): Automated benchmark run complete: https://ci.redwood/invoke/bench/3370004321

sasha: summary paste:

```
workload: longseq-1k
baseline (before PR 8421): p95=48ms, p50=10ms, mem_p95=1.2GB
canary (after PR 8421): p95=130ms, p50=11ms, mem_p95=1.4GB
throughput drop: ~18% on steady-state
```

ellie: that p50 is fine but p95 jump is bad. is this across all batch sizes or just 1k?

sasha: 1k shows the worst; 512 shows p95 ~70ms (was 46ms). microbatch change likely increases head-of-line for long contexts. I can attach the diffs in the artifact.

sam: any repro logs? stack traces? maybe the allocator introduced contention. can you dump `perf top` or flame?

sasha: attaching quick flame from canary node: s3://redwood-ci/bench/3370004321/flame.svg — it points to scheduler_wait and kv-cache-lock in the hot path.

jen: hmm sounds like the new allocator acquires a global lock during shard split. @kai can you comment on the recent allocator changes?

kai: yeah that matches my suspicion. the change added a brief global mutex to avoid concurrent shard moves. I thought it was low-impact but looks like for longseq with microbatching it queues up.

ellie: options: revert 8421, or push a targeted fix to avoid global lock (more work). do we have time to ship a fix this morning?

sasha: We're mid-canary (3/5 shards). I'm leaning revert to avoid customer exposure. Can someone +1 and either approve revert PR or open emergency revert?

sam: i can open a revert PR now and include a note to re-land after a less-global solution. will tag as hotfix.

kai: +1 for revert. i'll follow up with a patch that uses per-shard locks.

ellie: +1. also please add a regression test for longseq latency in the bench harness so this shows up earlier.

pr-bot: Opened PR #8437 — revert: revert "microbatch allocator shard-safety" (link: https://git.redwood/pr/8437)

sasha: thanks. can we pause the canary rollout until revert lands?

sam: pausing canary now. initiating `canary.pause` and pinning 8420 stable.

kai: i'll start a branch with per-shard lock changes and push draft later today.

jen: great. once revert merges, can we run a quick smoke bench before resuming? 5-10min bench on two shards should do.

sasha: agreed. i'll queue the smoke bench and tag this thread when results are in. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
